Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 13:17:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace activation / billing path for Redwood Inference

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — TechWave is excited to move Redwood onto our three-cloud procurement path (AWS + GCP + Azure). Procurement needs two things to kick off: a copy of your master services agreement (MSA) and the billing activation checklist for each marketplace so our cloud teams can enable the purchase flows.

Attached is our PO number (PO: 78921) and our onboarding intake form (filled). Can you confirm the correct legal name and tax ID to include on the PO, and whether Redwood prefers marketplace invoicing (via AWS/GCP/Azure invoices) or direct invoicing to procurement?

We'd like to get this routing done by the end of next week — please advise next steps and any additional docs needed.

Thanks,
Alice Huang
Vendor Ops | TechWave

procurement@techwave.com

Hi Alice — thanks for sending this over and for the clear PO. Quick answers up front:
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID (EIN): 12-3456789
- We support both marketplace invoicing and direct invoicing. For multi-cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) purchases we generally recommend marketplace procurement for faster activation, but direct invoicing is fine if your procurement/legal team requires it.

Next steps from our side: I'll loop in Finance (Marcus) to confirm invoicing preference and routing, and Legal (Laura) for a quick review of the MSA. I am attaching our Redwood Master SA (redacted for public view) and a short marketplace activation checklist for each provider.

Would appreciate you confirming which marketplace(s) you plan to use first (e.g., AWS GovCloud vs. commercial), and whether the PO needs Redwood to be a registered seller on any of their internal vendor portals.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Hi Alice — Marcus from Finance here. Thanks for the PO stub. A couple of operational items so we can process:
1) Please confirm billing address (line items on PO) and whether TechWave requires Net30, Net45, or immediate payment terms.
2) If you select direct invoicing, we will need: W9 (or W8 if non-US), invoice template example, and the contact/email to receive invoices.
3) If you prefer marketplace invoicing, please confirm the exact seller alias, because marketplace attribution must match our seller registration to attribute revenue correctly.

We can accept PO 78921 against the MSA once Laura confirms there are no redlines. If you want us to handle marketplace seller registration, Priyom (cc'd) can coordinate the partner side.

Thanks,

Hi Alice — Laura from Legal. I reviewed the MSA you received; no material redlines on our side. A couple of minor requests for the PO so procurement systems can map fields correctly:
- Please include the contract reference TW-DEAL-9812 on the PO if possible.
- Add a clause reference line: "Invoices submitted via marketplace will be payable under market terms; direct invoices will follow Redwood Net30."

Operational timeline (estimated):
- Seller registration + marketplace seller alias confirmation: 2–5 business days (Priyom will start registration today).
- Marketplace invoicing enablement (AWS/GCP): 5–10 business days after seller alias confirmed and market-side onboarding is accepted.
- Direct invoicing (if used): immediate once we receive W9 and invoice contact and process PO in our billing system.

Priyom — can you kick off the marketplace registrations with TechWave's cloud teams and confirm what metadata they require for the seller alias? Vanessa/Marcus — once Priyom confirms, we'll reply with the exact alias string to put on the PO.
